title: 会前会

title_tr.fa: جلسه هماهنگی قبل از جلسه اصلی

lines.text: 杰克发现，公司里的会有两种：一种开两个小时也定不下来，另一种五分钟就结束了。
lines.py: Jié kè fā xiàn, gōng sī lǐ de huì yǒu liǎng zhǒng: yì zhǒng kāi liǎng gè xiǎo shí yě dìng bú xià lái, lìng yì zhǒng wǔ fēn zhōng jiù jié shù le.
lines.en: Jack has noticed there are two kinds of meeting at the company: one kind goes on for two hours without deciding anything, and the other is over in five minutes.
